authentic_sources.name: COCO 2017 Dataset (Clean Partitions outside Historical Option P)
authentic_sources.license: Per-image Flickr license verified (CC-BY 2.0, CC-BY-SA 2.0, CC0, Flickr Commons; annotations CC-BY 4.0)
authentic_sources.license_audit_note: Do NOT assume all COCO images are CC-BY 4.0; Flickr source license must be verified per sample.
authentic_sources.provenance_tracking: Flickr image ID, author ID, Flickr URL, license name
authentic_sources.authenticity_note: Pre-2017 capture prevents modern text-to-image AI artifacts; does not mathematically guarantee zero analog/digital editing.

authentic_sources.license: Unsplash License (Free commercial/non-commercial research use and derivative creation)
authentic_sources.license_audit_note: Requires author attribution and record of photo ID and publication timestamp.
authentic_sources.provenance_tracking: Unsplash photo ID, author name, author profile URL, published_at date (<= 2021-12-31)

orthogonal_allocation_matrix.description: 2x2 Orthogonal balanced allocation of inpainting tools across authentic sources to control designed factors (does NOT eliminate unobserved confounding).
orthogonal_allocation_matrix.stratum_preserving_replacement_rule: If a candidate in stratum (S, T) fails technical QC, content QC, or disjoint checks, it is replaced solely by the next pre-ordered candidate in the EXACT SAME stratum (S, T) from the buffer pool. Zero quota re-allocation between strata is permitted.

canvas_and_codec_controls.mask_semantics: Mask defines inpainting request area supplied to diffusion pipeline (pixel 0 = keep background, pixel 255 = inpaint region); it is not guaranteed pixel invariance boundary due to VAE/latent encoding.
canvas_and_codec_controls.scientific_interpretation: Canvas/codec normalization controls output container and resolution parity between pairs. It does NOT claim to erase pre-existing sensor JPEG compression history or eliminate all potential pipeline shortcuts.

inclusion_criteria: Image must decode successfully with Pillow without errors.
Pixel dimensions must be exactly 512x512 RGB.
Binary mask PNG (512x512) must accompany each ai_edited sample with values in {0, 255}.
Must pass decompression bomb guard (<= 50,000,000 pixels).
Verified provenance documentation for authentic image including license and author.
No solid black, white, blank, or NaN/Inf pixel tensors.
exclusion_criteria: Overlap with any of 684 historical Option P sources by source_id.
Overlap with any historical Option P image by raw_sha256 or master_sha256.
Overlap with any historical Option P image by origin_id / Flickr URL.
Resolution mismatch between authentic and ai_edited within the same source.
Synthetic or non-photographic authentic images (e.g., pure computer graphics, screenshots, text diagrams).

sampling_and_stopping_rule.rule: Process candidate pairs in prespecified random order per stratum; lock and seal cohort manifest immediately upon reaching exactly 100 verified valid pairs per stratum (400 total). Zero model scoring permitted during collection.

detector_isolation_invariant.rule: Zero calls to candidate detector models (visual_calibrated, late_fusion_dsp_augmented, or any of the 5 fold models) during candidate listing, downloading, inpainting generation, technical QC, content QC, or manifest creation.
